name: Dryreach
summary: Dryreach is an Aluvian frontier fortress forever besieged by Hea Tumeroks, who use it as a training ground; its gates are kept locked and the surrounding zone spawns tougher creatures than the rest of Middle Osteth. In the world it is an 84 x 132 m walled rectangle on a flat green plain (z 18): four five-story stone towers with tall spire roofs (top 48.8) at the corners, low stone curtain walls topped with sharpened wooden stakes, a gatehouse in each side, and inside a courtyard with a central well, the Town Network portal and a handful of Aluvian cottages; Tumerok camps and stake palisades dot the plain to the north-east.

landmarks.note: Wall top 23 with wooden stakes to 25; gatehouses on all four sides.

landmarks.name: Portal to Town Network
landmarks.note: North-west courtyard, 22 m inside the north gate.

landmarks.name: Tumerok camp palisade
landmarks.note: Stake palisade NE of the fort.

shots.standingOrder: Descend in a wide slow spiral over the plain toward the walled fortress of Dryreach with its four spired towers in the golden light; stay 10 m above the spire tips.
shots.notes: Arrival: wide counter-clockwise spiral descent from 80 m to 40 m above the plain (radius 140->96 m) toward the fortress, its four 31 m spire towers and spiked palisade glowing in the low golden sun from behind the camera. Clearance: 31 m to the nearest tower, >= 9 m above the spire tips at the end; vmax 10.6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Glide south along the sunlit west palisade of Dryreach past its gate and spiked stakes, 13 m off the wall and 2.5 m up; nothing may come between lens and wall.
shots.notes: The town's facade pan (fortress wall): glides 32 m south along the west palisade and gatehouse, 13 m off the stone and 2.5 m above the flat plain, the golden western sun at the camera's back lighting the wall, its wooden stakes and the gate. Clearance: 11.3 m to the wall, query-radius 4 m = 0, nearest tree 19 m; vmax 4.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Pass straight over the Dryreach courtyard from east to west 30 m up, keeping the well in frame through vertical as the golden light rakes the walls; stay 12 m above every roof and spire.
shots.notes: Pass-over: straight east-to-west pass 30 m above the courtyard (z 48), the gimbal yaw-slewing through vertical over the well with the cottages, portal and spired corners rotating beneath. Clearance 19.8 m to the nearest roof, tower tips 48.8 never closer than 30 m horizontally; 6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up outside the north gate until the lens clears the palisade stakes and looks down on the blue Town Network portal in the courtyard; stay 12 m from the wall.
shots.notes: Particle reveal: pedestal rises 12 m outside the north gate (40 m from the portal): first the gate and stakes fill the frame, then the lens clears the palisade (top ~25) and looks down on the blue Town Network portal in the NW courtyard (blocked 27/49 samples by design, clear from t~6.7). Clearance: 11.7 m to the nearest bush, 12.5 m to the NW tower; vmax 1.6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Cross the north-west spire 6 m above its tip, then dive straight down its north face 5 m off the stone and pull out low over the plain heading north; never closer than 3 m to the tower or trees.
shots.notes: Hero FPV dive (JEV): crosses the NW spire tower level at z 56 (7 m above its tip), crests and dives at -78 deg down the north face 5 m off the stone, pulls out 3 m above the plain and races 40 m north. Clearance: >= 4.6 m from the tower box at the closest, trees >= 19 m; fpv preset, vmax 11.7 m/s (cap 25).
